# libbladerf2

**Library and udev rules for Nuand bladeRF boards**

- **Version recorded:** 0.2024.05
- **Categories:** `sdr-hardware`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/Nuand/bladeRF>

## What it does

The shared library the bladeRF host tools and SoapySDR module are built against, together with the udev rules that make the boards accessible without root.

## Why you would want it

Nothing reaches a bladeRF without it, and its udev rules are the reason the hardware entry's identifiers are confirmed rather than guessed — they were read from this package's own rules.

## Before it will work

bladeRF hardware. Firmware and FPGA images are separate and version- sensitive.

## Install and launch

- **Installed by name only** — it is in no profile.
- **Install:** `hammunition install libbladerf2 --dry-run`, read the plan, then run it without `--dry-run`.
- **Launch:** Its package ships its own commands and application-menu entry; a unit that ships none gets a generated terminal entry (**D-050**). `hammunition status` lists what is installed.
- **The install needs the network to:** your distribution's package archive.

## Offline use

*Not yet documented for this application.* Read “Before it will work” above for what it needs; the install-time network line above is the only offline fact generated from the manifest. Internet, a local network and a radio link are three different things, and this page does not claim any of them works until it says so.

## How it installs

- apt: `libbladerf2`

## Known problems

Debian 13, Parrot and Ubuntu 26.04 ship 0.2024.05 while Kali ships 0.2025.10 (apt-cache policy, 2026-08-28), and the FPGA image must match the library version. The x40, x115 and 2.0 micro are different boards with different images.

## Keeping it current

- probe: apt policy
- strategy: apt_upgrade
